name: Poly Pin Manager
author: polyxgo

sections.description:
Pin Manager provides a feature that supports pinning plugins, themes, categories, posts, pages, and tags to the top of the list for easy handling. Additionally, the note feature corresponding to each pinned element will make it easier for you to manage them on the site.

Try a Live Demo

  1. View a demo website

Watch a Tutorial

Current Features

  • Pin/ Unpin: Pin Plugins, Themes, Tags, and Categories.
  • Notes Workspace: Dedicated workspace to search, filter, and bulk manage all developer notes.
  • Export & Import: Export and import pinning configuration and notes (JSON/ZIP).
  • Code Editor: Quick Access to Code Editor.
  • Note: Attach Notes and Descriptions.
  • Quick Access Menu: Create Custom Menu Lists.
  • Language Switcher: Language Menu on the Top Bar.

Support

For support, please visit https://headrandom.com/products/poly-pin-manager-for-wordpress
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP 7.4 or greater is required (PHP 8.0 or greater is recommended)
  • MySQL 5.6 or greater, OR MariaDB version 10.1 or greater, is required
  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/poly-pin-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress. Then, in the display section for plugins, themes, categories, tags, etc., you will see a pin button next to its name.
  3. Use the Settings->Pin Manager screen to configure the plugin.
  4. Refer to the feature guide list here: https://headrandom.com/products/poly-pin-manager-for-wordpress
sections.faq:
Where to find help?

  • First-time users should read https://headrandom.com/products/poly-pin-manager-for-wordpress, which explains the basics and includes a lot of screenshots and shortcodes.

  • Update to the new plugin version at: https://headrandom.com/products/poly-pin-manager-for-wordpress and WordPress.org https://wordpress.org/plugins/poly-pin-manager, where we share and provide free support or sell our products.

Can I pin WooCommerce product categories and tags?

  • Yes, you can pin any product category to the top of the list. Additionally, post categories and other custom taxonomies are also supported.

Will the categories displayed on the frontend be affected?

  • No, the pin feature only works on the admin side. The display of categories, products, and posts on your site will not be affected.

Will the notes be lost when unpinning?

  • No, since this feature supports developers, the notes will not be deleted when you unpin a plugin. However, if you delete or reset the Pin Manager data beforehand, the note information will be lost.

Can I request new features?

  • Yes, as a developer aiming to support customer work, integrating new features is always considered. For useful and suitable features, we will definitely integrate them.
sections.changelog:
Version 2.5.0 (August 26, 2026)

NEW

  • Added Admin Notes Search & Filter Management Workspace (Dedicated screen under Pin Manager > Notes Workspace to search, filter, and bulk edit all developer notes).
  • Added Export & Import Configuration feature (Export all pinning options and notes into JSON/ZIP and restore seamlessly across sites).

Version 2.4.1 (May 22, 2025)

FIXED

  • Fixed issue where CSS and JS assets were not updating with new plugin versions.
  • Fixed issue where pinned plugins list did not display action links, update buttons, and status notices.

Version 2.4.0 (May 19, 2025)

NEW

  • Enable quick access feature for editing plugins/themes.
  • Support enabling/disabling pin feature per post type, category, taxonomy.

CHANGED

  • Convert setting features from checkbox to toggle button.

Version 2.3.2 (March 04, 2025)

FIXED

  • Fix issue where posts, pages, categories, etc., do not display when in Trash status.

Version 2.3.1 (February 12, 2025)

FIXED

  • Fixed the issue where the Quick Access Menu list was not being saved.

Version 2.3.0 (February 5, 2025)

NEW

  • Integrate tooltips for quick preview of note content when hovering over note icon.
  • Integrate scroll bar when note content is too long on popup.

CHANGED

  • Adjust pinning tool for Theme to appear before Theme name, avoiding conflicts with WordPress styles.

FIXED

  • Fixed note issue for Pages format.

Version 2.2.1 (February 1, 2025)

UPDATED

– Added and adjusted translations.
– Modified the logic for handling notes on plugins and themes.

CHANGED

– Adjusted issues based on the recommendations from the WordPress.org Team Guidelines.

FIXED

– Fixed missing nonce errors in POST data operations.
– Fixed the issue in WooCommerce product category lists where pinned categories caused subcategories to be hidden.

Version 1.0.0 (September 06, 2024)

NEW

– Release version.
